hints.title: Sort Dishes by Satisfaction
hints.text: Dishes with higher satisfaction should be cooked later to multiply by larger time factors.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Contribution
hints.text: Adding a new dish to the beginning adds the entire running sum of chosen dishes to total satisfaction.

hints.title: Greedy Stop Condition
hints.text: Iterate backwards from highest to lowest satisfaction. Keep adding dishes as long as running sum remains positive.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all subsets of dishes to cook takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting dishes and maintaining cumulative prefix sums yields optimal O(N log N) runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts array ascending and adds dishes from largest to smallest while cumulative sum > 0.
